row.notes: Whole body read. Maps item_id 0x6e/0x6f/0x70/0x71 to mode 3/1/0/4 (any other id gives 5) and stores the byte at tile+0x328; posts a bus message (vtable 0x14578f230) with the mode string from table 0x14578f1a0 and msg_arg; loads layout 'display_upsell', 'display_upsell_grid' (mode 4) or 'display_upsell_fixed_layout' (mode 2) through 0x143859a70([tile+0x248], 0x1d, name) and copies the result into tile+0x260..+0x320 (inline 0x80 string at +0x288, fields +0x308..+0x320). Caller Ui_PurchasePopup_Refresh passes the int at +0x220 of its current record; caller FeTile_Find_UnlockItemByEntrantLabel passes the id of the matched row or -1 when no row matches. Good hook point to see which upsell layout opens. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
